intro: Little Cloud Baby Shampoo by 100 Years of Ayurveda is a safe and gentle hair cleanser made especially for babies.
Its tear-free formula ensures a joyful bath experience, while the blend of natural Ayurvedic ingredients cleanses the scalp, nourishes the hair, and leaves it soft, shiny, and smooth.
This mild shampoo is perfect for everyday use, keeping your baby’s hair healthy without any harsh chemicals.
